title: Convex subgroup chains are bounded by rational rank
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a totally ordered abelian group, such as the value group attached to a valuation ring of a field [def-weil-field] and put $\operatorname{rrk}(\Gamma)=\dim_{\mathbf Q}(\Gamma\otimes_{\mathbf Z}\mathbf Q)\in\{0,1,2,\dots\}\cup\{\infty\}$. If $H_0\subsetneq H_1\subsetneq\dots\subsetneq H_n$ is a strict chain of convex subgroups of $\Gamma$, then $n\le\operatorname{rrk}(\Gamma)$.

source.place: §2.1, pp. 7–8, the convex-rank/height consequence of the value-group correspondence, checked alongside Lemma 2.1.2 and Corollary 2.1.3(i) in the author’s v3 PDF online at https://math.huji.ac.il/~temkin/papers/Stable_Modification.pdf.
